summary: This note describes Troy Independent School District, a school district located in Bell County. The district extends into a small portion of Falls County. Besides the town of Troy, it also serves the unincorporated communities of Pendleton, Belfalls, and Oenaville.
one_line: Troy Independent School District is a Texas school district in Bell County that also reaches a small part of Falls County and serves several unincorporated communities.
key_facts: Troy Independent School District is located in Bell County.
The district extends into a small portion of Falls County.
In addition to Troy, the district serves the unincorporated community of Pendleton.
In addition to Troy, the district serves the unincorporated community of Belfalls.
In addition to Troy, the district serves the unincorporated community of Oenaville.
